body:
Hello, I'd like to translate ASVS to Turkish if it's OK with you.

I couldn't find any Turkish translation except 4.0.1 version. I can start translating 5.0 or any other version you want.

comments.body:
Thanks for your interest :)

At this point, I would strongly suggest waiting a few months as by then we will hopefully have a finalised version 5.0 which you can translate.

If you really want to do a translation of v4.0.3 we have more guidance [here](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#translations) but given I am not sure when exactly we will be able to integrate it as we are working hard on 5.0 right now...
Thank you for your attention. I'd like to wait for the finalized version of 5.0 and start translating it.

> Thank you for your attention. I'd like to wait for the finalized version of 5.0 and start translating it.

That seems reasonable :) 

I close this issue, as there is no immediate action to wait from this at the moment.

labels.name: _5.0 - Not blocker
labels.description: This issue does not block 5.0 so if it gets addressed then great, if not then fine.

title: Turkish translation
